name: biomed-workbench
description: Biomedical research orchestration with evidence-linked bulk, single-cell, spatial, universal analysis, and publication review.

interface.longDescription: One research entry that separates bulk, single-cell, spatial, and universal methods; routes evidence, molecular, imaging, clinical, experimental, and publication work; and preserves scientific review and provenance across the project.
defaultPrompt: Use biomed-workbench for donor-aware single-cell analysis and target-journal result writing.
Use biomed-workbench to design a bulk sequencing study, separating assay, target, controls, and normalization.
Use biomed-workbench to search evidence, run relevant analysis, and draft a publication-grade output.
